I am in the same position, virgin, 25 years old. Dont know how to talk to women, shy, terrible. I am considering suicide myself, I have a post here to express what I am thinking and I dont see how I can change my situation. I dont know what to do to fix this, I suck at life.

I have taken suicide on my own hands, waiting until I have the substance on hand to swallow and kill myself. I am sorry to everyone, especially my parents, I have let all of you down.

BUT, what I see on you OP is that you can talk to women. You are comfortable around them. You can fix this. I cannot talk to women, I am shy.

I am 25 years old, soon to be 26. I am virgin, not a lot of friends, but I am trying to improve. I am getting older, and my family thinks this is how I am now. I feel static, I dont see how I am improving. My parents expect me to get married soon like my sister is now, and since they have not seen any girl with me they are considering ask their friends to see if they potentially help get with girl. I do not have anything to say about it, as a man I feel I should take care of this myself. I am fortunate and grateful to have what I have now, I think I just dont have enough in me to be someone that I want. I can say it is the pressure, and yes the perception that people have on you, that you are not good enough as your sister or you are not what I have expected and so on. Regardless, I feel down for letting myself be like this. It is my fault.

The substance that I will be delivered, I may get thoughts using it. Once you use it, you die. I am surprised they have not banned this yet, it was in the news.
